repositories.name: security-audit-skill
repositories.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
repositories.summary: 这是一个编码代理技能，让代理按六个阶段执行安全审计，产出可机器读取且经独立验证的漏洞发现。

repositories.name: vllm
repositories.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
repositories.summary: vLLM 是一个高吞吐、显存高效的大语言模型推理与服务引擎，用于快速部署和运行各类 LLM。

repositories.name: orca
repositories.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repositories.summary: Orca 是一个用 TypeScript 开发的 AI 编码代理编排工具，可在桌面、移动端和远程环境并行运行多个 CLI 代理，并在同一处统一跟踪管理。

repositories.name: headroom
repositories.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
repositories.summary: Headroom 是一个在内容送入大模型前压缩工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 片段的 Python 库，可减少 token 消耗，并提供代理和 MCP 服务器。

repositories.name: ponytail
repositories.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repositories.summary: Ponytail 是一个提示词工具，可装入 AI 编程代理，让它像资深开发者一样用最少代码完成任务。

repositories.name: ComfyUI
repositories.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
repositories.summary: ComfyUI 是一个基于节点图界面的模块化扩散模型引擎，用于在本地构建和运行图像、视频、音频等 AI 生成工作流。

repositories.name: supabase
repositories.description: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
repositories.summary: Supabase 是基于 Postgres 的开源开发平台，提供数据库、认证、自动生成 API、实时订阅、存储和 AI 工具，用于构建 Web、移动和 AI 应用。

repositories.name: twenty
repositories.description: The open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI.
repositories.summary: Twenty 是一个开源 CRM 系统，面向技术团队，支持用代码定义对象、字段和视图，构建并版本化管理可定制的客户关系管理应用。

repositories.name: Kronos
repositories.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
repositories.summary: Kronos 是面向金融市场 K 线序列的开源基础模型，可对 OHLCV 数据进行量化预测，并支持微调。

repositories.name: freehire
repositories.description: freehire — the open-source search engine for job seekers
repositories.summary: freehire 是一个用 Go 开发的开源 IT 职位搜索引擎，直接从公司招聘页面抓取职位，供求职者搜索。

repositories.name: ai-memory
repositories.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
repositories.summary: ai-memory 是面向 AI 编程代理的长期记忆工具，可在不同代理间交接任务，避免重复说明架构与失败尝试。

repositories.name: graphify
repositories.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repositories.summary: Graphify 是一个 Python 工具，可将代码库及其文档、SQL 模式、配置和 PDF 解析为可查询的知识图谱，供 Claude Code 等 AI 助手使用。
